Strategy: Prefer room for exactly one more. A leftover fitting exactly one more item of this size is the most efficient reusable space: one more item fills it with no excess stranded. Score by leftover with a bonus when it holds one more same-size item but not two, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to that band. Exact fits tie at the top. It may help by right-sizing leftovers, but may fail by passing up tighter fills.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item if item <= r - item < item * 2 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: One-more-item band bonus: +item when leftover in [item, 2*item).
